r1.defect: PrepareBatchInputs/BuildFullMask accepted chunk_start/chunk_valid outside the fixed 4096-token window; chunk_start=4096 drove cache_col_start negative and wrote before the mask buffer (reviewer mask-boundary driver, ASan heap-buffer-overflow WRITE at gemma4_text_inputs.cpp:42, rc -6)
r1.fix: ValidateMaskGeometry rejects nonpositive seq_len, seq_len > kCacheLen, negative chunk_start/chunk_valid, chunk_valid > seq_len, and chunk_start > kCacheLen - seq_len before any buffer access; enforced in BuildFullMask/BuildSlidingMask (plus null-buffer rejection) and PrepareBatchInputs (which also validates token count == chunk_valid and the prebuilt-hidden extent); PrepareDecodeInputs rejects positions outside [0, kCacheLen); QuantizeMask rejects negative dimensions and null buffers
r1.no_clamping: Requests that do not fit the fixed context are rejected, never silently clamped; valid 4096-window generation (chunks 0..3840) and the boundary window chunk_start=3840/chunk_valid=256 are covered by tests

r2.defect: ContinueGenerate/ContinueGenerateStream indexed full_hidden as whole-prompt rows without any extent check; a one-float vector read 6144 bytes past its end through PrepareBatchInputs (reviewer short-hidden driver, ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ, rc -6)
r2.fix: ContinueGenerateStream validates at entry (overflow-safe) that full_hidden holds exactly full_ids.size()*kHiddenSize floats, before any session mutation or stage read; PrepareBatchInputs takes the hidden as a vector pointer (const std::vector<float>*) so the public preparation API can establish its own extent (>= (chunk_start+chunk_valid)*kHiddenSize); GenerateWithPromptEmbeddings' existing exact-size check unchanged
